newsitem.title: UK: Air France ups frequencies to Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Air France ups frequencies to Vietnam.

text.p: Air France said it will launch a third weekly frequency to Hanoi from Paris Charles de Gaulle on December 15, 1996.

The new frequency has been made possible because of an agreement signed last August between Air France and Vietnam Airlines. Air France will operate to Hanoi with one stopover in Bangkok on Tuesdays, Fridays and Saturdays with return flights from Hanoi on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays.
Air France also operates to Ho Chi Minh City three times each week. With this added service to Hanoi, Air France will offer six flights per week to and from Vietnam.

The agreement signed in August last year represents a new stage in the cooperation between the two airlines with each able to increase its services between Paris and Vietnam, as well as previewing the possibility of Vietnam Airlines to block seats on Air France flights between Paris and Frankfurt and between Paris and Berlin effectively making Charles de Gaulle the European hub of the Vietnamese carrier. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
